description: Full physicochemical comparison of the AP3D1 N-terminal helix with adaptin paralogs, membrane-inserting helices, ALPS motifs and a surface-binding control, with Eisenberg and face-composition plots
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, math
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def useq(a):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30); r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
ACC={"AP3D1_HUMAN":"O14617","AP3D1_MOUSE":"O54774","AP3D_CHICK":"A0A8V1AAZ3","AP3D_DROME":"P54362",
 "APD3_CAEEL":"O16637","APL5_YEAST":"Q08951","AP1G1_HUMAN":"O43747","AP2A1_HUMAN":"O95782",
 "AP2B1_HUMAN":"P63010","AP3B1_HUMAN":"O00203","AP4E1_HUMAN":"Q9UPM8","ARFGAP1":"Q8N6T3",
 "NUP133":"Q8WUM0","TRIP11":"Q15643","ATG14":"Q6ZNE5","APOA1":"P02647","AMPH":"P49418",
 "BIN1":"O00499","EPN1":"Q9Y6I3","SAR1A":"Q9NR31","SNCA":"P37840","ARF1":"P84077"}
S={k:useq(a) for k,a in ACC.items()}

EIS=dict(A=.62,R=-2.53,N=-.78,D=-.90,C=.29,Q=-.85,E=-.74,G=.48,H=-.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,
         M=.64,F=1.19,P=.12,S=-.18,T=-.05,W=.81,Y=.26,V=1.08)
# Wimley-White interfacial scale (kcal/mol, negative = favourable partitioning into POPC interface)
WWI=dict(A=.17,R=.81,N=.42,D=1.23,C=-.24,Q=.58,E=2.02,G=.01,H=.96,I=-.31,L=-.56,K=.99,M=-.23,
         F=-1.13,P=.45,S=.13,T=.14,W=-1.85,Y=-.94,V=.07)
CHG=dict(D=-1,E=-1,K=1,R=1,H=.1); BULKY=set("FWYLIMV"); SMALL=set("AGSTCP")
def metrics(seq,angle=100.):
    n=len(seq); th=np.deg2rad(np.arange(n)*angle); h=np.array([EIS[a] for a in seq])
    mx=(h*np.cos(th)).sum(); my=(h*np.sin(th)).sum(); muH=math.hypot(mx,my)/n
    phi=math.atan2(my,mx); d=np.angle(np.exp(1j*(th-phi)))
    face=[seq[i] for i in range(n) if abs(d[i])<=np.pi/2]
    ddg_face=sum(WWI[a] for a in face)
    return dict(muH=muH, meanH=h.mean(), net=sum(CHG.get(a,0) for a in seq),
        frac_chg=sum(1 for a in seq if a in "DEKR")/n, ST=sum(1 for a in seq if a in "ST")/n,
        face="".join(face), face_bulky=sum(1 for a in face if a in BULKY)/len(face),
        face_small=sum(1 for a in face if a in SMALL)/len(face),
        dG_face_WW=ddg_face, dG_face_per_res=ddg_face/len(face), n=n)

panel={
 "AP3D1 human 1-24":(S["AP3D1_HUMAN"][:24],"AP-3 delta (query)"),
 "AP3D1 human 1-14":(S["AP3D1_HUMAN"][:14],"AP-3 delta (query)"),
 "AP3D1 mouse 1-24":(S["AP3D1_MOUSE"][:24],"AP-3 delta (query)"),
 "AP3D chicken 1-24":(S["AP3D_CHICK"][:24],"AP-3 delta (query)"),
 "AP3D Drosophila 1-24":(S["AP3D_DROME"][:24],"AP-3 delta (query)"),
 "APD-3 C.elegans 1-24":(S["APD3_CAEEL"][:24],"AP-3 delta (query)"),
 "Apl5 yeast 1-24":(S["APL5_YEAST"][:24],"AP-3 delta (query)"),
 "AP1G1 1-24":(S["AP1G1_HUMAN"][:24],"adaptin paralog control"),
 "AP2A1 1-24":(S["AP2A1_HUMAN"][:24],"adaptin paralog control"),
 "AP2B1 1-24":(S["AP2B1_HUMAN"][:24],"adaptin paralog control"),
 "AP3B1 1-24":(S["AP3B1_HUMAN"][:24],"adaptin paralog control"),
 "AP4E1 1-24":(S["AP4E1_HUMAN"][:24],"adaptin paralog control"),
 "epsin1 H0 1-18":(S["EPN1"][:18],"membrane-inserting"),
 "amphiphysin1 H0 1-27":(S["AMPH"][:27],"membrane-inserting"),
 "BIN1 H0 1-27":(S["BIN1"][:27],"membrane-inserting"),
 "alpha-synuclein 1-25":(S["SNCA"][:25],"membrane-inserting"),
 "Sar1A 1-23":(S["SAR1A"][:23],"membrane-inserting"),
 "Arf1 1-17":(S["ARF1"][:17],"membrane-inserting"),
 "ArfGAP1 ALPS1":(S["ARFGAP1"][203:226],"ALPS curvature sensor"),
 "ArfGAP1 ALPS2":(S["ARFGAP1"][231:256],"ALPS curvature sensor"),
 "Nup133 ALPS":(S["NUP133"][252:274],"ALPS curvature sensor"),
 "GMAP210 ALPS":(S["TRIP11"][:38],"ALPS curvature sensor"),
 "ATG14 ALPS":(S["ATG14"][463:492],"ALPS curvature sensor"),
 "ApoA-I class A 220-241":(S["APOA1"][219:241],"surface-binding control"),
}
rows=[]
for k,(sq,cl) in panel.items():
    m=metrics(sq); m.update(name=k, cls=cl, seq=sq); rows.append(m)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)[["name","cls","seq","n","muH","meanH","net","frac_chg","ST",
                       "face","face_bulky","face_small","dG_face_WW","dG_face_per_res"]]
pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",40)
print(df.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.3f}"))
print("\nCSV:\n"+df.to_csv(index=False))

# ---- figure ----
colmap={"AP-3 delta (query)":"#C0392B","adaptin paralog control":"#7F8C8D",
        "membrane-inserting":"#2E86C1","ALPS curvature sensor":"#1E8449",
        "surface-binding control":"#B7950B"}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6))
ax=axes[0]
for cl,g in df.groupby("cls"):
    ax.scatter(g.meanH,g.muH,s=90,c=colmap[cl],label=cl,edgecolor="k",linewidth=.5,zorder=3)
for r in df.itertuples():
    ax.annotate(r.name,(r.meanH,r.muH),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords="offset points")
x=np.linspace(-.6,.6,10); ax.plot(x,0.5-0.6*x,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("mean hydrophobicity <H> (Eisenberg consensus)")
ax.set_ylabel("hydrophobic moment per residue $\\mu$H")
ax.set_title("Eisenberg plot of the AP3D1 N-terminal segment\nagainst benchmark amphipathic helices")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left"); ax.grid(alpha=.25)

ax=axes[1]
for cl,g in df.groupby("cls"):
    ax.scatter(g.face_small,g.face_bulky,s=90,c=colmap[cl],label=cl,edgecolor="k",linewidth=.5,zorder=3)
for r in df.itertuples():
    ax.annotate(r.name,(r.face_small,r.face_bulky),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords="offset points")
ax.set_xlabel("fraction of small residues (A,G,S,T,C,P) on the hydrophobic face")
ax.set_ylabel("fraction of bulky residues (F,W,Y,L,I,M,V) on the hydrophobic face")
ax.set_title("Hydrophobic-face composition:\nALPS motifs are small-residue rich, classic inserting helices are bulky")
ax.grid(alpha=.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
